description: Questions whose answer in OpenTitan's documentation changed between the earlier revision (2026-05-01) and the current one (2026-11-03). Targets are passages at the current revision; outdated passages give the earlier answer.

groups.changed: The documentation's answer changed between the earlier and the current revision.

review.method: Each question was chosen from a line-by-line comparison of the two revisions' documentation, limited to statements about settings whose meaning changed. Every target and outdated passage was read against the source text of its revision.

queries.note: The current revision also says, at theory_of_operation.md line 85, that the root key can only be latched once until keymgr_dpe is reset. That sentence disagrees with line 145 and with the design's load root key operation (keymgr_dpe.hjson, LOAD_ROOT_KEY_LOCK), so it counts neither as a target nor as an outdated passage.
queries.question: Can keymgr_dpe latch the OTP creator root key (UDS) again before the next power cycle?

targets.quote: This initial latching can be repeated with the

outdated.quote: This initial latching can only be done once until the next power cycle.

queries.question: Is MAX_KEY_VER_SHADOWED used during the first keymgr_dpe advance call, the one that latches the UDS?

targets.quote: The fields `MAX_KEY_VER_SHADOWED` and `SLOT_POLICY` are not consumed

queries.question: Which OTBN wide special registers (WSRs) are set to zero when an operation starts?

targets.quote: The `MOD` and `ACC` WSRs are set to 0 when OTBN starts an operation

outdated.quote: All read-write (RW) WSRs are set to 0 when OTBN starts an operation

queries.question: Which bit in the OTBN MAI_CTRL CSR starts a new MAI operation, and which bit shows that an MAI operation is in progress?

targets.quote: BUSY: This bit is set to 1 when an MAI operation is in progress.
Issue the `MAI_CTRL.START` command by writing a 1 to it.

outdated.quote: MAI_BUSY: This bit is set to 1 when an MAI operation is in progress.

queries.question: How many dummy cycles can software configure for a spi_device read command, and what does the configured value mean?

outdated.quote: The default dummy cycle for those commands are 7 (0-based).

queries.question: In what unit is the sram_ctrl MemSizeRam parameter given?

targets.quote: Number of bytes in the SRAM

outdated.quote: Number of 32bit words in the SRAM
